page.layout: One block of text in a single column, running head at the top, page number at upper right; catchword "cùm" at the lower right; signature "H 6" at the foot left of it. No marginal notes beyond small show-through marks at the edges, which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: quosdam nobis insultare: nec cogitare quàm multa ipsi fortasse non repperissent, si primi quaesissent. Non sum tam Lynceus, inquiunt, quàm mihi videor. Egóne? testor te summe Deus, non videor: & si quid olim in calidâ illâ œtate calidius, abiit, & veris me pretiis nunc æstimo & pendo. Quo longius in hac vitæ viâ progredior, magis magisque aspicio circumfusam animo caliginem, corpori imbecillitatem. Heracleitus, ut opinor, olim dicere solitus, Se

page.notes: The first word "quosdam" is printed "quofdam" with long s; transcribed with plain s. The line "Egóne ?" carries a space before the question mark as printed. Small marks at the left and right edges are show-through or stains and are omitted. The page furniture "H 6" is the signature and "cùm" the catchword.
